# Part A-Creating Vectors and List:
```{r}

worker_age <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 43, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24,33, 41, 53, 40, 18, 44, 38, 41, 48, 27, 39, 19, 30, 61, 54, 58, 26, 18)

length(worker_age)

min(worker_age)
max(worker_age)

worker_age[c(13:18, 33:35)]
worker_age[c(10, 20, 30, 40)]

worker_age[c(4, 14, 24)] <- 0
worker_age

```
Question 1
a. Create a vector for the worker’s age.
  worker_age <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 43, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24,33, 41, 53, 40, 18, 44, 38, 41, 48, 27, 39, 19, 30, 61, 54, 58, 26, 18)

b.How many data points?
  There are 50 data points the vector worker_age.

c. Find the minimum and the maximum value of worker’s age.
  The minimum value is 17 and the maximum value is 61.

d. Access the 13rd to 18th elements and 33th to 35th elements of worker’s Age.
   worker_age[c(13:18, 33:35)]
    [1] 27 22 37 34 19 20 33 41 53

e. Access all but the 10th, 20th, 30th and 40th elements are not included.
  worker_age[c(10, 20, 30, 40)]
  [1] 29 49 51 41

f. Modify the 4th, 14th, 24th, and 44th elements with value = 0.
  worker_age[c(4, 14, 24)] <- 0
   worker_age
 [1] 34 28 22  0 27 18 52 39 42 29 35 31 27  0 37 34 19 20 57 49 50 37 46  0 17 37 43 53 41 51 35 24 33 41
[35] 53 40 18 44 38 41 48 27 39 19 30 61 54 58 26 18

Question 2
```{r}
data(rivers)



length(rivers)
sum(rivers)
mean(rivers)
median(rivers)
var(rivers)
sd(rivers)
min(rivers)
max(rivers)

rivers_stats <- c(length(rivers), sum(rivers), mean(rivers), median(rivers), var(rivers), sd(rivers), min(rivers), max(rivers))

rivers_stats
 

```
Question 2
a. Get the number of elements (length) in rivers, their sum (sum), mean (mean), median(median), variance(var), standard deviation(sd), minimum (min) and maximum (max)

> var(rivers)

> sd(rivers)

Question 4

```{r}
  vegetables <- list(
  "Carrot", "Potato", "Cabbage", "Broccoli",
  "Eggplant", "Squash", "Spinach", "Onion",
  "Tomato", "Okra"
)


vegetables <- append(
  vegetables, list("Corn", "Cucumber")
)
vegetables
length(vegetables)

vegetables <- append(
  vegetables,
  list("Lettuce", "Radish", "Celery", "Pepper"),
  after = 5
)
vegetables

length(vegetables)
```
